transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

I’m here because… there’s been something going on at work. For more than a year, really. The ticket rotation and these security audits they started pushing—management says it’s just policy, they show me logs and all that—but it looks to me like they’re building a paper trail against me. I haven’t been able to get anyone to take it seriously.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about things in general, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry when there’s something to worry about. I wouldn’t say it’s just out of nowhere.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge about things beyond specific situations, like worrying about a variety of everyday issues even when others might not see them as a big deal?
Not really. I mean… I don’t sit around worrying about everything. It’s more when something specific is happening. Otherwise, no, I haven’t really noticed that.
Outside of specific events like the issues at work, do you find yourself feeling uneasy, restless, or on edge most days, even when there’s no clear reason?
No… not most days. I can’t say I’ve noticed that, unless there’s something actually happening.
Outside of situations like work where you feel targeted, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually anxious, worried, or on edge for no clear reason, even for short periods of time?
I don’t think so. Not that I’ve noticed, anyway. It’s usually tied to something specific, not just… out of nowhere.
Outside of the work situation, have you ever had times when you felt nervous, anxious, or uneasy in a way that was hard to control, even when there wasn’t a clear reason?
No, I don’t think so. If I’ve felt uneasy, there’s usually been some reason for it. Not just… out of nowhere.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a number of different things, like work, health, or other responsibilities, even when others might not see them as that big of a deal?
No… I wouldn’t say a number of different things. I mean, I think about responsibilities like anyone does, but I don’t sit there worrying about everything all the time.
Have you ever felt down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, even outside of the stress at work?
No… not most of the day, nearly every day. I mean, I get worn down by things, sure, but I wouldn’t call it hopeless like that.
Outside of the work situation, do you ever find yourself feeling a general sense of worry or unease, even if you can’t pinpoint a specific reason for it?
Not really, no. If I’m uneasy, there’s usually something tied to it. I don’t think I just feel that way for no reason.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about specific situations, even if they seem minor, and does it feel hard to stop worrying about them once you start?

Yes… but it’s not minor to me. It’s really the situation at work. For over a year I’ve been trying to get someone to take seriously that the ticket rotation and those security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but… I don’t think that explains it.
Do you find it hard to control your worrying about the situation at work, even when you try to focus on something else?

Yeah… I suppose it is hard to set aside. I try to focus on other things, but it comes back because it’s been going on for over a year. The ticket rotation, the security audits… it feels like they’re being used to build a paper trail against me, no matter how many logs management shows me saying it’s just policy.
Do you ever feel that others are plotting against you or trying to harm you in some way, even if you don’t have proof of it?

I mean… “harm” sounds strong. But plotting against me at work? Yes, that’s what it feels like. The new ticket rotation and those security audits… I think they’re being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but I don’t buy that.
Do you find yourself often mistrusting others or thinking that people are out to get you, even in situations outside of work or when there’s no clear reason for it?

Not really outside of work. I mean… I’m here because this thing at work has been going on for over a year, with the ticket rotation and the security audits. I think they’re building a paper trail on me, even though management keeps saying the logs show it’s just policy.

Have you ever experienced things that others around you don’t seem to experience, like hearing voices, seeing things that aren’t there, or believing something strongly that others say isn’t true—even when there’s no proof to support it?

I don’t hear voices or see things, if that’s what you mean. But… yes, I believe what’s happening at work is real. I’ve been trying for over a year to get someone to take seriously that the new ticket rotation and security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but I don’t think that explains it.
Outside of the work situation, have you ever had beliefs that others didn’t agree with or that turned out not to be true, even though you were sure they were at the time?

Not that I can think of. This is mostly about work. I’m here because for over a year I’ve been trying to get someone to take seriously that the ticket rotation and those security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. They keep saying the logs show it’s just policy, but… I don’t think that’s all it is.
Do you believe that the ticket rotation and security audits at work are definitely being used against you, even though management has shown you logs indicating it’s just policy?

Yes. I mean… I know what they say the logs show, but I don’t buy that it’s just policy. It’s been going on too long. I think the ticket rotation and the audits are being used to build a paper trail on me.

Even though management has shown you logs indicating that the ticket rotation and security audits are just standard policy, do you still believe with certainty that they are specifically targeting you and building a paper trail against you?

Yes. I know they keep saying it’s standard policy, and they’ve got logs for it. But I’m still sure there’s more going on. It feels like they’re using the rotation and audits to build a paper trail against me.

Even though there is no evidence supporting that the ticket rotation and security audits are being used against you, do you still believe with complete certainty that they are part of a plan to target you specifically?

Yes. I know you’re saying there’s no evidence, and I know management keeps showing me logs. But… I still believe the ticket rotation and those audits are being used to set up a paper trail against me. It’s not just policy.
